content:
The 77th Emmy Awards ceremony was held, and Apple's new CEO John Ternus attended in person. Ternus officially took over from Tim Cook to lead Apple two weeks ago, and he couldn't wait to show off the unreleased iPhone Duo in person at the star-studded event and in front of reporters.

Deadline reporters captured footage of Ternus arriving at the Emmy Awards venue, taking the unreleased iPhone Duo out of his tuxedo jacket pocket.

Apple's first foldable iPhone will go on sale next month, starting at $1,999. But before that, Apple TV+ still has awards to compete for. Stay tuned.
